prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: transparent PNG object pictogram for a technical e-learning slide. Primary request: one isolated rolling-element bearing with a short shaft through it and two small opposing force arrows that clearly indicate mechanical load. Style/medium: minimalist flat 2D RelTest Education pictogram, orthographic front view, clean geometric silhouette with strong consistent outlines. Composition: centered on a square canvas, exactly one dominant bearing motif, 8 percent transparent safety margin, recognizable at 48 px. Color palette: Marine blue #142452 only. Constraints: genuinely transparent background; no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark; no motor, no gear cluster, no scene. Avoid: 3D, isometric view, photorealism, gradients, shadows, glow, textures, neon, emoji, sticker or clip-art look.
